name: Ijimete Maniac!!
original_name: イジめて まにあっく!!
source:
A friend since childhood, a neat girl in the same school, and an innocent girl younger than the protagonist...
Perverted world lead by the three girls who hide sadistic nature.
The protagonist realizes his forbidden nature. What will become of him...?

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE017930.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
青梅竹马、同校的清纯女孩，以及比主人公年幼的天真女孩…
三名隐藏着施虐本性的女孩，引领他进入一个扭曲的世界。
主人公察觉到自己被禁止的天性。他最终会变成什么样…？

[摘自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE017930.html]DLSite English[/url]]
